exposure: typical sonographic signs of PAS disorder
Presence vs. absence of ultrasound signs of PAS disorder
Patients with at least one typical sonographic sign of PAS disorder in combination with ICL
cohort: 332 women with placenta previa or low-lying placenta at ≥ 26 weeks' gestation
finding: The presence of ICL on ultrasound was independently associated with major postpartum hemorrhage, Cesarean hysterectomy, and placenta percreta, but not with the presence of any PAS disorder.
